It was contested by 18 teams.<ref name=Rothmans/> [[Club Brugge K.V.]] won the championship with 51 pts, [[KV Mechelen]] came a close second with 49, and [[Royal Antwerp FC]] came third, also with 49 pts.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Oliver |first1=Guy |title=The Guinness record of world soccer : the history of the game in over 150 countries |date=1992 |publisher=Guinness |location=Enfield |isbn=978-0-85112-954-9 |page=192 |url=https://archive.org/details/guinnessrecordof0000oliv/page/192/mode/2up |access-date=24 November 2025}}</ref> [[K.A.A. Gent]] & [[R. Jet Wavre|Racing Jet de Bruxelles]] were relegated.<ref name=Rothmans/>
